name: zero-damage-clamp-seed0
description: Damage clamps to zero when negative Strength would push it below. Player has StrengthPower(-10) (allow_negative=True per Python); player attacks Cultist for 6 raw → 6 + (-10) = -4 → max(0, -4) = 0. Cultist HP unchanged (48). Verifies the final clamp at the bottom of the damage pipeline.
